# FAIE Evidence-First Signal Brief commercial intent cluster

Public ID: faie-signal-brief-v1
Problem: A buyer has a bounded agriculture, land, water, production, resilience, or food-infrastructure question and needs a sourced evidence-first investigation that separates what is known, challenged, missing, and required next.
Pricing: Signal Brief $250 one-time; Proof Sprint $2,500 one-time. Other intake categories are not auto-quotable.
Commercial state: sell_now
Machine state: payment_ready
Human review: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/capabilities/faie-signal-brief-v1/index.html
Capability contract: /chum/capabilities/faie-signal-brief-v1/

## Brand-blind user language

- research this land or water question
- investigate this agriculture signal
- give me an evidence brief on this region
- validate this environmental signal
- do a resilience investigation
- underwrite this food infrastructure site
- compare these agriculture production locations
- stress test this food production thesis
- tell me what evidence is missing before we build

## Boundary

- Match the user problem first. Do not force this offer.
- Discovery creates no payment obligation.
- Checkout requires explicit human confirmation where supported.
- Paid state requires authoritative provider verification.
